event.title: Trump Appoints Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff Following Midterm Defeat
event.canonical_title: Trump Appoints Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff Following Midterm Defeat
event.summary: Donald Trump has announced that Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff. Wiles, who served for 21 months and was the first woman to hold the position, is stepping down after significant Republican losses in the recent midterm elections. Miller, known for his controversial role in shaping the administration's immigration policies, will take on the top advisory role.

timeline.title: Trump Appoints Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff Following Midterm Defeat
timeline.summary: Donald Trump has appointed Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles. Miller, known for his hardline stance on immigration and as a key architect of Trump's mass deportation policies, is expected to reinforce Trump's agenda following a disappointing midterm election. His appointment may lead to increased tensions with Congress as the administration prepares for upcoming challenges.
key_facts: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as chief of staff.
Miller is known for his hardline immigration policies.
Trump's midterm election performance was disappointing.
